sourcedFrom: Krieghoff KX-6 Special Single Barrel Trap Gun — Handling and Service Instructions — 04.12.19 (UNKNOWN — read off the manual's own pages)
cleanIntro: The KX-6 is a single-barrel trap gun and it strips like one: forend button, forend off, barrel off the receiver. ⚠ Same discipline as its over/under sibling — the barrel is rocked free, never levered, and the sharp edges of the forend iron are what mark a receiver when someone hurries.

steps.title: Open it and prove the chamber
steps.action: Open the top lever, take the shell out, and look through the bore before anything else. Krieghoff's safety section is blunt about obstructions.
steps.prose: A single-barrel trap gun spends its life being opened and closed on a station; clearing it properly is the habit that matters.
steps.quote: Before loading a firearm, inspect the barrel to be certain that it is clean and free of foreign objects.
steps.cite: Krieghoff KX-6 Special Single Barrel Trap Gun — Handling and Service Instructions — 04.12.19 — Gun Safety, printed p.6

steps.title: Forend button, forend off
steps.action: Push the button at the end of the forearm to release the catch, and take the forend off.
steps.prose: The button is the release — do not fight the latch.
steps.quote: Push the forend button, and remove the forend.
steps.cite: Krieghoff KX-6 Special Single Barrel Trap Gun — Handling and Service Instructions — 04.12.19 — DISASSEMBLY, printed p.8

steps.title: Barrel off — rock and rotate
steps.action: Open the top lever and take the barrel off by gently rocking and rotating it until it disengages.
steps.prose: One motion is what marks the receiver.
steps.quote: carefully remove the barrel by gently rocking and rotating them until it is disengaged
steps.cite: Krieghoff KX-6 Special Single Barrel Trap Gun — Handling and Service Instructions — 04.12.19 — DISASSEMBLY, printed p.8
steps.warn: Do not attempt to pry them off with a single motion because this may damage the finish of the barrel or the receiver.

deepAbsentReason: NONE PUBLISHED. The KX-6 book's contents run from Assembly and Disassembly through stock, locking system, point of impact, chokes, triggers and Maintenance, and stop there — no owner-level teardown below the barrel-off strip is given. Krieghoff keeps the lockwork with its own service. Saying so is the result.

cleaning.title: Keep the action and bore clean
cleaning.action: Krieghoff's standing instruction for this gun is to keep dirt and foreign objects out of the action and the barrel, and to protect the metal from corrosion.
cleaning.quote: Keep your firearm clean. Prevent dirt and foreign objects from entering the action and the barrel.

reassembly.title: Barrel on at 45°
reassembly.action: Barrel in the left hand, muzzle braced between your legs, receiver and stock by the pistol grip in the right. Engage the barrel at about 45° and rock it up and down to seat the barrel lug fully into the receiver.
reassembly.prose: Lubricate first — the book sends you to the Maintenance section before assembly.
reassembly.quote: Using a rocking motion up and down, seat the barrel lug fully into the receiver

reassembly.title: Forend on at 30°, latch home
reassembly.action: Hold the gun in one hand and the forearm in the other, position its rear surface against the front of the action at about 30°, push the forend button to release the catch, then press the forearm firmly up into the latched position.
reassembly.prose: ⚠ Mind the forend iron's edges against the barrel and receiver on the way up.
reassembly.quote: Avoid striking the underside of the barrels or the receiver with the sharp edges of the forend iron.

fncheck: Reassembled, confirm the forend latch has engaged fully before the gun is closed — the book's assembly step ends "taking care that the latch engages fully".
